description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various linguistic categories, as indicated by the horizontal axis labeled "tag." The horizontal axis displays discrete categories, with visible labels including "gender," "number," and "tense," alongside an unlabeled leftmost group. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," employs a linear scale with visible numeric tick marks at intervals of 5, ranging from 5 to 20, with horizontal grid lines corresponding to these intervals; however, the bars originate from a baseline below the 5 mark, near 0. Within each category on the horizontal axis, the data is represented by a group of six adjacent bars. While the legend in the upper right is partially obscured, it indicates that the colors correspond to different models, with the dark red bar explicitly labeled "XLM-B2." The consistent color order from left to right within each group is light blue, dark blue, light green, dark green, light red, and dark red. All bars feature black outlines and are visually emphasized with black, I-beam style error bars extending above and below the top edge of each bar. The values vary across the groups; the tallest bars are the light red and dark red bars in the leftmost unlabeled group, reaching approximately 17 on the vertical axis. Conversely, the shortest bars are found in the "tense" category, where the dark blue, light green, and dark green bars have values near 0. The categories on the horizontal axis do not follow an obvious alphabetical or value-based sorting order, and the entire chart is presented at a tilted angle.
